description: Encryption at rest missing on the two resource types the bundled rules cover. ArchiveBucket declares no BucketEncryption property at all. AnalyticsDatabase declares StorageEncrypted: false, the explicit form of the same defect, on a property RDS cannot change in place after creation. Both resources are otherwise correctly configured: the bucket blocks public access, logs its access elsewhere and is tagged; the database sits in a private subnet group with PubliclyAccessible: false, a seven day backup retention window, deletion protection, and the same tags. The master password is managed by RDS rather than declared, so the template contains no credential.

expected_findings.note: No BucketEncryption property on the bucket, reported by the s3_bucket_encryption Guard rule.
StorageEncrypted: false on the DB instance, reported by the rds_storage_encrypted Guard rule.
